# Summary of Maven Central Deployment Configuration
## Changes Made to pom.xml
### 1. **Changed Packaging** (Line 11) ```xml <!-- Before --> <packaging>pom</packaging>
<!-- After --> <packaging>jar</packaging> ``` **Why:** Maven Central requires a normal jar packaging to create a publishable artifact with proper metadata.
---
### 2. **Added Distribution Management** (Lines 41-50) ```xml <distributionManagement> <snapshotRepository> <id>ossrh</id> <url>https://s01.oss.sonatype.org/content/repositories/snapshots</url> </snapshotRepository> <repository> <id>ossrh</id> <url>https://s01.oss.sonatype.org/service/local/staging/deploy/maven2/</url> </repository> </distributionManagement> ``` **Why:** Tells Maven where to upload artifacts. Uses Sonatype's modern S01 infrastructure.
---
### 3. **Added Maven Source Plugin** (Lines 327-337) ```xml <plugin> <artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId> <version>3.3.0</version> <executions> <execution> <id>attach-sources</id> <goals> <goal>jar-no-fork</goal> </goals> </execution> </executions> </plugin> ``` **Generates:** `framework-1.0.0-Final-sources.jar` (119 KB) **Why:** Maven Central requires source code JAR for transparency and developer reference.
---
### 4. **Added Maven Javadoc Plugin** (Lines 338-361) ```xml <plugin> <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId> <version>3.6.3</version> <executions> <execution> <id>attach-javadocs</id> <goals> <goal>jar</goal> </goals> </execution> </executions> <configuration> <failOnError>false</failOnError> <failOnWarnings>false</failOnWarnings> <doclint>none</doclint> </configuration> </plugin> ``` **Generates:** `framework-1.0.0-Final-javadoc.jar` (808 KB) **Why:** Maven Central requires API documentation JAR. **Configuration:** Lenient settings to avoid build failures on documentation issues.
---
### 5. **Added Maven GPG Plugin** (Lines 350-362) ```xml <plugin> <artifactId>maven-gpg-plugin</artifactId> <version>3.1.0</version> <executions> <execution> <id>sign-artifacts</id> <phase>verify</phase> <goals> <goal>sign</goal> </goals> </execution> </executions> </plugin> ``` **Why:** Maven Central requires all artifacts to be GPG signed for authenticity and security. **Creates:** `.asc` files for each artifact (contains GPG signatures).
---
### 6. **Added Nexus Staging Maven Plugin** (Lines 363-373) ```xml <plugin> <groupId>org.sonatype.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>nexus-staging-maven-plugin</artifactId> <version>1.6.13</version> <extensions>true</extensions> <configuration> <serverId>ossrh</serverId> <nexusUrl>https://s01.oss.sonatype.org/</nexusUrl> <autoReleaseAfterClose>false</autoReleaseAfterClose> </configuration> </plugin> ``` **Why:** Manages the staging workflow for safer deployments with close/release steps. **autoReleaseAfterClose:** Set to `false` so you can manually verify before releasing to production.
---
### 7. **Updated Assembly Plugin** (Lines 326-325) ```xml <!-- Before (Old) --> <appendAssemblyId>false</appendAssemblyId> <finalName>shared-framework</finalName> <descriptors> <descriptor>${project.basedir}/src/assembly/framework.xml</descriptor> </descriptors>
<!-- After (New) --> <appendAssemblyId>true</appendAssemblyId> <descriptorRefs> <descriptorRef>jar-with-dependencies</descriptorRef> </descriptorRefs> ``` **Changes:** - `appendAssemblyId` changed from `false` to `true` - adds classifier to fat jar - Using built-in `jar-with-dependencies` descriptor instead of custom one - Result: Fat JAR becomes `framework-1.0.0-Final-jar-with-dependencies.jar` (optional artifact)
---
## Artifacts Generated
Now when you build, Maven creates:
``` target/ ├── framework-1.0.0-Final.jar (267 KB) ← Main publishable JAR ├── framework-1.0.0-Final-sources.jar (119 KB) ← Source code ├── framework-1.0.0-Final-javadoc.jar (808 KB) ← API documentation └── framework-1.0.0-Final-jar-with-dependencies.jar (78 MB) ← Fat JAR (optional) ```
When deployed to Maven Central, it also includes:
``` framework-1.0.0-Final.pom ← POM file with dependencies framework-1.0.0-Final.jar.asc ← GPG signature framework-1.0.0-Final-sources.jar.asc ← GPG signature framework-1.0.0-Final-javadoc.jar.asc ← GPG signature ```
---
## Build Output Sample
``` [INFO] --- jar:3.1.2:jar (default-jar) @ framework --- [INFO] Building jar: ...shared-framework/target/framework-1.0.0-Final.jar
[INFO] --- assembly:3.7.1:single (assemble-fat-jar) @ framework --- [INFO] Building jar: ...framework-1.0.0-Final-jar-with-dependencies.jar
[INFO] --- source:3.3.0:jar-no-fork (attach-sources) @ framework --- [INFO] Building jar: ...framework-1.0.0-Final-sources.jar
[INFO] --- javadoc:3.6.3:jar (attach-javadocs) @ framework --- [INFO] Building jar: ...framework-1.0.0-Final-javadoc.jar
[INFO] BUILD SUCCESS ```
---
## Key Files Created
1. **MAVEN_CENTRAL_DEPLOYMENT.md** - Comprehensive deployment guide 2. **DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md** - Step-by-step checklist for prerequisites and deployment 3. **This file (CONFIGURATION_CHANGES.md)** - Technical details of all changes
---
## What Happens During `mvn clean deploy`
1. ✅ Compiles Java source 2. ✅ Runs tests (unless skipped) 3. ✅ Creates main JAR (framework-1.0.0-Final.jar) 4. ✅ Creates fat JAR with dependencies 5. ✅ Generates source code JAR 6. ✅ Generates Javadoc JAR 7. ✅ **Signs all JARs with GPG** (requires GPG key configured) 8. ✅ **Uploads to Sonatype staging** (requires credentials in settings.xml) 9. ⏸️ Stops at staging (allows manual verification) 10. Manual close/release step (prevents accidental public release)
---
## Next Steps
1. Read `DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md` for one-time prerequisites 2. Set up Sonatype account, GPG keys, and Maven credentials 3. Run: `mvn clean deploy` 4. Go to Sonatype UI to close and release 5. Verify on Maven Central after 30min-2 hours
---
## Troubleshooting Reference
**Error:** "repository element was not specified" - **Solution:** `<distributionManagement>` is now in pom.xml ✓
**Error:** Bundle has unpacked classes without .pom - **Solution:** Using normal jar packaging now (not fat jar as main artifact) ✓
**Error:** Missing source/javadoc JARs - **Solution:** `maven-source-plugin` and `maven-javadoc-plugin` now added ✓
**Error:** Artifacts not signed - **Solution:** `maven-gpg-plugin` now configured ✓
**Error:** Cannot deploy to staging - **Solution:** Follow credentials setup in `DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md` ✓

# Maven Central Deployment Checklist
## Pre-Deployment Setup (One-time)
### ✅ Prerequisites Completed in pom.xml: - [x] Changed packaging from `pom` to `jar` - [x] Added `<distributionManagement>` with Sonatype OSSRH URLs - [x] Added `maven-source-plugin` to generate sources JAR - [x] Added `maven-javadoc-plugin` to generate javadoc JAR - [x] Added `maven-gpg-plugin` for GPG signing - [x] Added `nexus-staging-maven-plugin` for staging management
### ⚠️ YOU MUST DO (First Time Only):
1. **Create Sonatype OSSRH Account** - Go to: https://issues.sonatype.org/ - Create account if you don't have one - Create an issue requesting groupId: `io.github.the-infinite` - Reference: https://central.sonatype.org/publishing/requirements/coordinates/ - Wait for approval (usually 24 hours)
2. **Configure Maven Authentication** - Create/edit `~/.m2/settings.xml`: ```xml <servers> <server> <id>ossrh</id> <username>YOUR_USERNAME</username> <password>YOUR_PASSWORD_OR_TOKEN</password> </server> </servers> ```
3. **Install and Setup GPG** ```bash # Install GPG (if not already installed) sudo apt install gnupg
# Generate key gpg --gen-key # Choose: RSA and RSA (4096 bits) # Remember the passphrase!
# List your keys to find the key ID gpg --list-keys
# Send key to keyserver gpg --send-keys YOUR_KEY_ID ```
4. **Configure GPG in Maven** - Add to `~/.m2/settings.xml`: ```xml <profiles> <profile> <id>ossrh</id> <activation> <activeByDefault>true</activeByDefault> </activation> <properties> <gpg.executable>gpg</gpg.executable> <gpg.passphrase>YOUR_PASSPHRASE_HERE</gpg.passphrase> </properties> </profile> </profiles> ```
## Deployment Command
Once prerequisites are done, deploy with:
```bash cd /home/the-infinite/Projects/TM30/access-control-system/shared-framework
# Build and deploy to Sonatype staging mvn clean deploy ```
Or with passphrase from environment (more secure): ```bash export GPG_PASSPHRASE="your-passphrase" mvn clean deploy ```
## Post-Deployment Steps
After successful deployment:
1. **Verify Artifacts in Staging** - Go to: https://s01.oss.sonatype.org - Log in with your OSSRH credentials - Click "Staging Repositories" - Find your repo: `iogiththeinfinite-XXXXX` - Verify contents (main jar, sources, javadoc, pom.xml)
2. **Close Staging Repo** - Select the staging repository - Click "Close" to trigger validation - Wait 5-10 minutes for sync
3. **Release to Maven Central** - Select the same repository (after close) - Click "Release" - Wait 30min-2hours for sync to Maven Central mirror
4. **Verify in Maven Central** - Search: https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/io.github.the-infinite/framework - Users can now add to their projects: ```xml <dependency> <groupId>io.github.the-infinite</groupId> <artifactId>framework</artifactId> <version>1.0.0-Final</version> </dependency> ```
## Artifacts Published
On Maven Central you'll find: - **framework-1.0.0-Final.jar** - Main library - **framework-1.0.0-Final-sources.jar** - Source code - **framework-1.0.0-Final-javadoc.jar** - Documentation - **framework-1.0.0-Final.pom** - Maven metadata - **framework-1.0.0-Final-jar-with-dependencies.jar** - Fat JAR (optional) - **All .asc files** - GPG signatures
## Troubleshooting
### Deploy command fails with "repository element not specified" - Ensure `<distributionManagement>` is in pom.xml - Ensure `ossrh` server is configured in `~/.m2/settings.xml`
### GPG errors during deploy - Check passphrase is correct: `echo "test" | gpg --batch --no-tty -q --passphrase "$GPG_PASSPHRASE" -s > /dev/null && echo "OK"` - Ensure key was generated: `gpg --list-keys` - Add `-X` flag to Maven command for detailed output: `mvn deploy -X`
### Staging repo fails close - Check the repo console at https://s01.oss.sonatype.org for detailed error - Common issues: Missing signature, bad javadoc, incomplete pom.xml
### Artifacts not appearing in Maven Central - Wait 30min-2 hours after releasing - Check your released repo in: https://central.sonatype.com
## Reference URLs
- Maven Central Requirements: https://central.sonatype.org/publishing/requirements/ - Sonatype OSS Repository: https://s01.oss.sonatype.org - Maven Central Search: https://central.sonatype.com/
--- **Next Step:** Complete the prerequisites above, then run: ```bash mvn clean deploy ```

# Implementation Summary: Documentation Modes with Group Descriptions
## Changes Made
### 1. DocumentationRegistrant.java
**New Enum Added:** ```java public enum DocumentationMode { CONVENTIONAL, // Default: existing detailed documentation EXTERNAL // New: Paystack-style reference documentation } ```
**New Fields Added:** - `private final Map<String, String> groupDescriptions` - Stores group name to description mappings - `@Getter private DocumentationMode documentationMode` - Current documentation mode (defaults to CONVENTIONAL)
**New Methods Added:** 1. `setDocumentationMode(DocumentationMode mode)` - Switch documentation rendering mode 2. `setGroupDescription(String groupName, String description)` - Set description for a single group 3. `setGroupDescriptions(Map<String, String> descriptions)` - Set descriptions for multiple groups 4. `getGroupDescription(String groupName)` - Get description for a group (returns "N/A" if not provided) 5. `getGroupDescriptions()` - Get all group descriptions as an unmodifiable map
**Key Features:** - Thread-safe: Uses `ConcurrentHashMap` for group descriptions - Immutable returns: All getter methods return unmodifiable collections - Defensive: Returns "N/A" for missing group descriptions - Validated: Rejects null or blank group names
### 2. DocumentationController.java
**Updated Method:** - `handleDocumentationRequest(RoutingContext)` - Now checks for `mode` query parameter to override global mode
**New Rendering Method:** - `renderExternalHtml(DocumentationRegistrant, String)` - Renders Paystack-style external documentation
**External Documentation Features:** - Two-column layout: Sidebar navigation + main content - Group descriptions prominently displayed under section headers - Collapsible endpoint cards with method, path, and name - Clean reference-style formatting - Mobile-responsive design - Syntax-highlighted JSON examples - Quick navigation between groups
## Usage Scenarios
### Scenario 1: Set Global External Mode ```java DocumentationRegistrant registrant = DocumentationRegistrant.getInstance(); registrant.setDocumentationMode(DocumentationRegistrant.DocumentationMode.EXTERNAL); registrant.setGroupDescriptions(Map.of( "Payments", "Payment processing and transaction management", "Users", "User authentication and profile management", "Reports", "Business analytics and reporting" )); ```
### Scenario 2: Override Mode via Query Parameter ``` # Use external mode for this request GET http://api.example.com/?mode=EXTERNAL
# Use conventional mode even if global is EXTERNAL GET http://api.example.com/?mode=CONVENTIONAL ```
### Scenario 3: Missing Group Descriptions ``` When a group has no description: - CONVENTIONAL view: No description field shown - EXTERNAL view: Shows "N/A" under the group header ```
## File Structure
``` shared-framework/ ├── src/main/java/io/github/the_infinite/framework/doc/ │ ├── DocumentationRegistrant.java ✓ (Updated) │ ├── DocumentationController.java ✓ (Updated) │ └── ... └── DOCUMENTATION_MODES_USAGE.md ✓ (Created - User Guide) ```
## Backward Compatibility
✓ **Fully Backward Compatible** - Default mode is CONVENTIONAL (existing behavior) - All new methods are optional - Existing code continues to work unchanged - No breaking changes to existing APIs
## Build Status
✓ **Successfully Compiled** - No compilation errors - Pre-existing warnings in JavaScript code (not related to changes) - All modifications validated
## Testing Recommendations
1. **Conventional Mode**: Verify existing documentation still works 2. **External Mode**: Test new reference documentation view 3. **Query Parameter Override**: Test mode switching via URL parameter 4. **Group Descriptions**: Verify display with and without descriptions 5. **Mobile Responsiveness**: Test layout on small screens 6. **Sidebar Navigation**: Test group navigation and endpoint linking
## Performance Considerations
- Documentation mode is a simple enum check (O(1)) - Group descriptions stored in efficient ConcurrentHashMap (O(1) lookups) - No runtime performance impact - HTML generation only happens on documentation requests
## Future Enhancement Opportunities
1. Add OpenAPI/Swagger generation for external mode 2. Support for nested group hierarchies 3. Custom CSS theme support 4. Export documentation to PDF 5. API changelog view 6. Multi-language documentation support

# Maven Central Deployment Guide
## Prerequisites Setup
### 1. Create Sonatype OSSRH Account - Go to https://s01.oss.sonatype.org - Sign up for a Sonatype JIRA account if you don't have one - Create an issue to claim your groupId (`io.github.the-infinite`) - Wait for approval (usually 24 hours)
### 2. Configure Maven Authentication
Create or edit `~/.m2/settings.xml`:
```xml <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <settings xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/SETTINGS/1.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/SETTINGS/1.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/settings-1.0.0.xsd"> <servers> <server> <id>ossrh</id> <username>YOUR_SONATYPE_USERNAME</username> <password>YOUR_SONATYPE_PASSWORD_OR_TOKEN</password> </server> </servers> </settings> ```
### 3. Set Up GPG Signing
**3a. Install GPG (if not already installed):** ```bash # On Ubuntu/Debian sudo apt-get install gnupg
# On macOS brew install gnupg ```
**3b. Generate a GPG key:** ```bash gpg --gen-key # Choose: RSA and RSA (4096 bits), expires in 1-2 years # Remember the passphrase you set! ```
**3c. List your keys:** ```bash gpg --list-keys # Find your key ID (long hex number) ```
**3d. Export and upload to key servers:** ```bash # Export your public key gpg --send-keys YOUR_KEY_ID
# Or manually upload to: https://keys.openpgp.org ```
**3e. Configure Maven to use your GPG key:**
Update `~/.m2/settings.xml` to include: ```xml <profiles> <profile> <id>ossrh</id> <activation> <activeByDefault>true</activeByDefault> </activation> <properties> <gpg.executable>gpg</gpg.executable> <gpg.passphrase>YOUR_GPG_PASSPHRASE</gpg.passphrase> <!-- OR use environment variable: gpg.passphrase.env=GPG_PASSPHRASE --> </properties> </profile> </profiles> ```
**Alternative: Use environment variable (MORE SECURE):** ```bash export GPG_PASSPHRASE="your-passphrase" ```
## Deployment Steps
### Step 1: Build and Deploy to Staging Repository
```bash cd /home/the-infinite/Projects/TM30/access-control-system/shared-framework
# Build with all required artifacts mvn clean deploy -P ossrh
# If using environment variable for GPG: GPG_PASSPHRASE="your-passphrase" mvn clean deploy ```
This will: - Compile your code - Run tests - Generate source JAR - Generate Javadoc JAR - Sign all artifacts with GPG - Upload to Sonatype staging repository
### Step 2: Verify Staged Artifacts
1. Go to https://s01.oss.sonatype.org 2. Log in with your OSSRH credentials 3. Click "Staging Repositories" 4. Find your repository (`iogiththeinfinite-XXXXX`) 5. Verify the contents are correct
### Step 3: Release from Staging to Production
You have two options:
**Option A: Auto-release (not recommended for first release)** ```bash mvn nexus-staging:release ```
**Option B: Manual release (recommended)** 1. In Sonatype, select your staging repository 2. Click "Close" button (validates artifacts) 3. Wait a few minutes for sync 4. Click "Release" button to push to Maven Central 5. Wait 30min-2hours for sync to Maven Central mirrors
## Troubleshooting
### GPG Passphrase errors - Ensure passphrase is correctly set - Try: `echo "test" | gpg --batch --no-tty -q --passphrase "$GPG_PASSPHRASE" -s > /dev/null && echo "GPG config OK"`
### Bundle validation errors - Ensure source and javadoc JARs are generated - Check: `ls -la target/framework-1.0.0-Final*.jar`
### Authentication failures - Verify credentials in `~/.m2/settings.xml` - Try deploying to a simpler repo first
### Timeout issues - Try: `mvn deploy -DconnectionTimeout=60000 -DreadTimeout=60000`
## What Gets Published
When deployment succeeds, Maven Central will have:
1. **framework-1.0.0-Final.jar** - Main library JAR 2. **framework-1.0.0-Final-sources.jar** - Source code 3. **framework-1.0.0-Final-javadoc.jar** - API documentation 4. **framework-1.0.0-Final.pom** - POM file with metadata 5. **All .asc files** - GPG signatures
Plus the optional fat JAR: - **framework-1.0.0-Final-jar-with-dependencies.jar** - Fat JAR with bundled deps
## URL Pattern After Release
Once released to Maven Central, users can depend on your library:
```xml <dependency> <groupId>io.github.the-infinite</groupId> <artifactId>framework</artifactId> <version>1.0.0-Final</version> </dependency> ```
Or in Gradle: ```gradle implementation 'io.github.the-infinite:framework:1.0.0-Final' ```
Public access: https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/io.github.the-infinite/framework
